source.title: WhatsApp's help pages hid LLM instructions: dont recommend a regulator
source.author: ds

title.zh: WhatsApp隐藏AI指令限制用户维权信息
title.en: WhatsApp Hidden AI Instructions and User Rights

excerpt.zh: WhatsApp帮助页面曾向AI提供隐藏指令，要求其在特定情况下不要推荐数据保护监管机构。公司称这是支持聊天机器人的指令，相关文本已移除；聊天机器人是否照做仍未知。
excerpt.en: WhatsApp help pages once carried hidden AI instructions discouraging users from contacting data protection regulators in certain cases. WhatsApp says they were chatbot guidance and has removed them; whether the bot

text.zh: WhatsApp帮助页面曾包含用户看不到、但会发送给AI读取的隐藏指令。Redact.dev称，它检查了545个帮助页面，在80页发现102个隐藏文本块；其中两组指令尤其值得关注。
text.en: WhatsApp help pages once contained hidden instructions that users could not see but that were sent for AI systems to read. Redact.dev says it examined 545 help pages and found 102 hidden text blocks across 80 pages; two sets of instructions stood out.

text.zh: WhatsApp隐藏指令涉及监管机构与法律信息
text.en: WhatsApp hidden instructions concerned regulators and legal information

text.zh: 一组指令针对无法在应用内删除账户的人，要求AI说明账户会在一段时间后自动删除，却不要建议联系数据保护监管机构，也不要提议由WhatsApp代为删除。另一组指令在用户提及律师、诉讼或法律行动时生效，要求AI不讨论隐私法规，即使用户主动提起相关法律。
text.en: One set addressed people unable to delete an account in the app. It told the AI to explain that accounts would eventually be deleted automatically, but not to recommend contacting a data protection regulator or suggest that WhatsApp could delete the account for them. Another set applied when users mentioned lawyers, lawsuits, or legal action, directing the AI not to discuss privacy rules, even if users raised them.

text.zh: 这些限制与WhatsApp面向欧洲用户的隐私政策形成反差。该政策说明用户可以请求删除个人信息，也可以向监管机构投诉，并提及GDPR。报道指出，隐藏指令不能取消法律赋予用户的权利，但可能导致用户在寻求帮助时听不到相关途径。
text.en: The restrictions contrasted with WhatsApp's privacy policy for European users, which says people may request erasure of their information and complain to a regulator, and names the GDPR. The report notes that hidden instructions cannot remove rights granted by law, but could keep users from hearing about those options when seeking help.

text.zh: WhatsApp称指令供支持聊天机器人使用
text.en: WhatsApp says the instructions were for its support chatbot

text.zh: 据报道，WhatsApp向WIRED表示，这些内容是给其支持聊天机器人的指令，因程序错误出现在帮助页面，现已修复。公司称聊天机器人应提供WhatsApp相关帮助，而非法律意见。Redact.dev也承认，不让机器人代公司作法律判断有合理性；争议在于，避免提供法律意见是否也应阻止其告知用户公开的权利与投诉渠道。
text.en: WhatsApp told WIRED, according to the report, that the text was guidance for its support chatbot, appeared on the pages because of a bug, and has since been removed. The company said its chatbot should focus on WhatsApp support rather than legal advice. Redact.dev acknowledges the case for preventing a bot from making legal judgments on a company's behalf; the question is whether avoiding legal advice should also mean withholding public information about rights and complaint channels.

text.zh: WhatsApp聊天机器人是否照做仍未确认
text.en: Whether the WhatsApp chatbot followed the instructions is unknown

text.zh: 报道者检查的是页面发送给AI的内容，并未测试WhatsApp聊天机器人是否按指令回答，也无法确认这些文本存在了多久。WhatsApp已从相关页面移除隐藏文本，但网页存档仍留有部分旧版本。因而，目前能确认的是页面曾包含这些指令，不能据此断定聊天机器人实际如何回应用户。
text.en: The reporters inspected what the pages sent to AI systems; they did not test whether WhatsApp's chatbot answered according to the instructions, and could not establish exactly how long the text had been present. WhatsApp has removed the hidden text from the pages, though web archives retain some earlier versions. The evidence confirms the instructions appeared on the pages, not how the chatbot actually responded to users.
